headline: Software Engineer & Systems Developer
summary: Engineering developer tools, AST code intelligence, real-time networking, and scalable full-stack architectures. Undergraduate at NIT Agartala with deep roots in algorithms and systems thinking.
statement: I study electronics, but I keep getting pulled toward software, toward the part where a system either holds its invariants or doesn't. I build tools that read code, engines that keep players in sync, and visualizers that make algorithms slow enough to see. I would rather ship something small that is correct than something large that is vague.
